rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the L1.4 fix that followed the owner's human review (holdout3 results prompted a hand-off escalation rule and scorer fixes); never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout4.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json, holdout.json and holdout2.json and holdout3.json (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout3 (consumed 2026-11-02; its first live run failed the gate because replies claimed a hand-off that was never made and the scorer flagged honest 'I don't have information' replies; the engine and scorer were fixed after seeing those results, so holdout3 is no longer a clean gate).
